test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate article.

We have the opportunity to see ________ Great Lakes.
solution:
The correct answer is '**the**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The article **"the"** is used to refer to specific nouns that are known or identifiable to the speaker and listener.
 
• In this sentence, **"Great Lakes"** refers to a specific group of lakes, which makes the use of **"the"** appropriate.
 
• Options **"a"** and **"an"** are incorrect because they are used for singular, non-specific nouns.
 
• Option **"much"** is incorrect as it cannot be used as an article.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"We have the opportunity to see **the**__ Great Lakes."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "a"** is incorrect because "a" is used before singular, non-specific nouns.
 
• **Option 2: "an"** is incorrect because "an" is used before singular, non-specific nouns beginning with a vowel sound.
 
• **Option 4: "much"** is incorrect because "much" is not an article and cannot be used in this context.
